children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Repeatable commands and declarative patterns for inspecting, applying, reconciling, and rolling back Gameplane resources.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Treat status as controller output. Commit desired state, then wait for observedGeneration before declaring a rollout complete.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Use server-side apply for CRDs, query conditions directly, and keep credentials in referenced Secrets rather than manifests.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Separate platform resources from tenant workloads, pin modules by digest, and order Secrets before resources that reference them.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Use sync waves for CRDs, controllers, Secrets, then custom resources

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Ignore controller-owned status fields in drift detection

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Promote the same immutable module digest between environments

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Preview diffs, reconcile one scope at a time, verify conditions, and revert the Git commit or chart version when health gates fail.

children.name: Edit Page Body
